Senior Project Superintendent

Apply Now
BH-341732-1 Posted: 04/08/2026
  • $170000 - $190000 per annum
  • United States Texas Killeen
  • Permanent
  • Data Centre
Senior Project Superintendent – Data Center Construction

Build the Next Generation of Mission-Critical Infrastructure

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Superintendent to lead the field execution of large-scale data center construction projects. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing all on-site operations, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

You'll work closely with project teams, subcontractors, owners, and design partners to drive successful project delivery from groundbreaking through commissioning and turnover.

What You'll Do
  • Lead all field operations on large-scale data center construction projects.
  • Manage project safety, quality, schedule, productivity, and overall field execution.
  • Coordinate and supervise subcontractors, field superintendents, and craft personnel.
  • Develop and maintain construction schedules, labor plans, equipment, and material coordination.
  • Lead weekly coordination meetings and provide regular project updates.
  • Resolve field issues while coordinating RFIs, shop drawings, submittals, and design changes.
  • Ensure work complies with contract documents, project specifications, and quality standards.
  • Partner with project management teams to control costs and maintain project profitability.
  • Oversee commissioning activities, punch lists, system turnover, and project closeout.
  • Build strong relationships with owners, architects, engineers, and trade partners.

What We're Looking For
  • 8+ years of construction superintendent experience on mission-critical projects.
  • Experience leading projects valued at $50M+, with the ability to manage complex schedules and multiple trades.
  • Previous experience on data center or mission-critical strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, scheduling (CPM), quality control, safety, and cost management.
  • Proven leadership experience managing subcontractors, field teams, and project stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience preferred.

Why This Opportunity?
  • Lead complex, high-profile mission-critical construction projects.
  • Work with experienced project teams delivering industry-leading facilities.
  • Play a key leadership role from construction through commissioning.
  • Join a collaborative environment focused on safety, quality, innovation, and career growth.

Pay & Perks:
  • Salary + 20% uplift
  • weekly per diem
  • $7,500 one-time mobilization bonus
  • $1,000/month travel allowance to visit home
  • Competitive weekly salary
  • Bonus eligibility
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) + 401(k)
  • Health coverage beginning on your first day
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Health Savings and Wellness benefits
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Educational assistance
  • Employee-owner perks and wellness programs
  • Opportunity for long-term career growth with a 100% employee-owned organization


With over 90 years' combined experience, NES Fircroft (NES) is proud to be the world's leading engineering staffing provider spanning the Oil & Gas, Power & Renewables, Chemicals, Construction & Infrastructure, Life Sciences, Mining and Manufacturing sectors worldwide. With more than 80 offices in 45 countries, we are able to provide our clients with the engineering and technical expertise they need, wherever and whenever it is needed. We offer contractors far more than a traditional recruitment service, supporting with everything from securing visas and work permits, to providing market-leading benefits packages and accommodation, ensuring they are safely and compliantly able to support our clients.
Shanelle Baugh
